name: inherited-test-verdict
goal: Count validated inherited checks in entity verdicts without inventing fresh test runs

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Kernel closure at main ff47c377 has no fresh tests but two passing checks from kernel-closure-cases at aff45af. The scenario is proven, yet the global badge reports no tests. Count only recorded checks with sound origin and unaffected coverage; preserve provenance and missing/failure states.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: explorer-verdict and explorer-coverage-inherited already test references with checks, but fixtures always include a fresh generic test. Extend these standardized tests and runtime-evidence-ui review to an incremental record with no fresh tests; missing, failed, stale, unrelated and invalid origins must remain unproven.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed strengthened standardized tests as 5c30b86f. Two existing verdict tests fail on zero-fresh-test records; the existing browser inheritance flow reports Coverage incomplete: The record ran no test. Harness archived red record 0b0245bfbdd375827e01d0fea6190b4ef406b299e5d85c7bc2e86738a926acbf with 1255 frozen inputs.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The shared verdict reads inherited checks from existing unit-scoped coverage. Missing, failed, stale and invalid origins remain unproven. Fresh test arrays and origin identities remain unchanged; the same 15 unit tests and browser inheritance flow now pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The same browser flow passes at ea43f931 after failing at 5c30b86f. Harness sealed green record d785eb76b25587dc06508cadafe1ae4d06e61c1184fe200b578e073e924cf541; all 1255 frozen inputs, command and environment profile match.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: 559 reports tests, 14 recording/lineage/kernel tests, 11 shared evidence tests and 24 browser checks pass. Types, lint, formatting, reports build, audit and registry pass. Actual main record/case hashes and four outputs verified; live Kernel closure is green with original revision visible and no new browser errors. Full repository/Electron acceptance stays deferred during the native testing pause.
